sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered post-collision bundle states: protected collision points, member identities, travel distances, and vector-sum continuation courses.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Recover every frame gap, trace the emitted bundles to each earliest in-canvas geometric collision, and combine colliding courses by primitive vector sum.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Continue each surviving merged bundle from that event state until it cannot re-enter the finite canvas, painting only original background cells.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected case has sequential collisions. Replacing the vector-sum event state with a stopped bundle preserves the launchers and pre-collision trails but removes downstream continuation cells, so the final grid changes.

parametric_work.summary: Authored a general event-driven geometric ray-merging rule, constructive vector-sum/stop family, collision trace tool, adversarial audit, and portability regressions. Supports 2–6 demonstrations, exactly four private queries, matched inputs across both settings, and source-bound protected-Racket evidence.
